core_scope: Fixed target workload statistics physical design; PostgreSQL 16.14 supported base-restriction MCV+FD fragment

experiments.name: Census locality analysis
experiments.claim: Strict connected-component decomposition is ineffective, while affected-query locality remains useful.
experiments.scope: Census query-candidate graph, pair and pair+triple candidate constructions.
experiments.strongest_result: Two components; the giant contains 467/468 queries and all 2,253 pair candidates; mean pair-candidate degree 4.44.
experiments.does_not_establish: No general statement about other workloads or treewidth.

experiments.name: PostgreSQL creation/OID-order probe
experiments.claim: For overlapping MCV objects, physical creation/OID precedence can change the native estimate for a fixed selected set.
experiments.scope: PostgreSQL Census query.184 order probes.
experiments.strongest_result: Opposite creation orders for the same selected set produced radically different estimates.
experiments.does_not_establish: Precedence is not a universal DBMS design variable and arbitrary order optimization is not validated for the final mixed system.

experiments.name: First-applicable pilot
experiments.claim: A static first-statistic-wins model is insufficient; disjoint statistics compose and eligibility changes dynamically.
experiments.scope: Three Census query fixtures.
experiments.strongest_result: First-singleton prediction failed by as much as 98.91x.
experiments.does_not_establish: It is a hypothesis probe, not the final semantics.

experiments.name: MCV consumption/composition validation
experiments.claim: Dynamic winner consumption plus sequential numerical composition explains overlapping and disjoint MCV fixtures.
experiments.scope: Instrumented PostgreSQL MCV fixtures; rounded native observations.
experiments.strongest_result: Masking identified consumed winners; composed prediction within 1.0143x of rounded observations.
experiments.does_not_establish: Rounded observations do not prove floating-point semantic exactness.

experiments.name: CE-Replay-IR-v0
experiments.claim: A design-parametric GreedyCover replay can enumerate all subsets of a five-candidate fixture.
experiments.scope: Five MCV candidates; response values partly probed.
experiments.strongest_result: 32/32 designs within 5%; maximum relative error 1.08087%.
experiments.does_not_establish: Payload-derived semantics or raw native exactness.

experiments.name: CE-Replay-IR-v1-A
experiments.claim: MCV numerical responses can be derived from serialized native payload fields rather than singleton response probes.
experiments.scope: Four targets, 32 subsets each, rounded/clamped observation boundary.
experiments.strongest_result: 128/128 within 5%; maximum apparent error 1.7495%.
experiments.does_not_establish: The residual observation error prevented a raw exactness claim.

experiments.name: CE-Replay-IR-v1-B native raw validation
experiments.claim: Serialized MCV payloads plus executable replay match native pre-clamp supported CE at floating-point precision.
experiments.scope: PostgreSQL 16.14, base-relation MCV fixture, 4 targets x 32 designs.
experiments.strongest_result: 128/128 matches; maximum relative error 5.55e-16 before clamp_row_est().
experiments.does_not_establish: Full PostgreSQL CE, joins, parameterized paths, or unsupported predicate/statistics families.

experiments.name: CE-Replay-Optimize-v0
experiments.claim: Replay can serve as an offline objective evaluator whose global optimum matches exhaustive native PostgreSQL on a controlled design universe.
experiments.scope: One query, five MCV candidates, all 32 designs and all feasible budget thresholds.
experiments.strongest_result: Replay and native exhaustive optima agree at every threshold; deployed rows within 2.70e-16.
experiments.does_not_establish: Global optimality at workload scale.

experiments.name: CE-Replay-Optimize-v1
experiments.claim: Design-dependent replay evaluation changes design quality at the complete Census pair universe and dependency-local toggles avoid all-query replay.
experiments.scope: 468 Census queries, 2,253 pair MCV candidates, frozen target-100 payloads.
experiments.strongest_result: Full-scale losses random/singleton/marginal/local = 4922.86/6966.36/812.67/806.26; incremental toggle 47.7x wall-time and 107.3x replay-count reduction; 3,276/3,276 native matches.
experiments.does_not_establish: The 806.26 design is not a global optimum; naive SWAP took 278.677s.

experiments.name: CE-Replay-Optimize-v2
experiments.claim: Short semantic neighborhoods alone miss global budget exchanges; precedence refinement can matter.
experiments.scope: Census MCV local-search and reachable precedence experiments.
experiments.strongest_result: 58.23% of 3,768 improving swaps were disconnected budget exchanges; precedence refinement reached 802.113.
experiments.does_not_establish: A complete joint selection/precedence optimum.

experiments.name: CE-Replay-Optimize-v3 alternating selection/precedence
experiments.claim: Selection and PostgreSQL MCV precedence are coupled in the tested frozen design.
experiments.scope: MCV-only Census alternating local refinement.
experiments.strongest_result: Loss 812.671 to 795.512 in four alternating rounds.
experiments.does_not_establish: Global optimality or final mixed-system precedence optimization.

experiments.name: MCV-Deploy-v0
experiments.claim: Fresh physical MCV deployment preserves replay/native semantics while payload realization changes objective value.
experiments.scope: 209 MCV objects, PostgreSQL 16 Census deployment.
experiments.strongest_result: 468/468 matches, max semantic error 5.64e-15; frozen/fresh loss 795.512/813.802 (+2.2992%).
experiments.does_not_establish: Mixed-mechanism deployment or design-ranking robustness.

experiments.name: FD-Semantics-v0
experiments.claim: PostgreSQL dependency selection/application is externally executable and MCV-to-FD composition is directed through estimated clauses.
experiments.scope: PostgreSQL 16.14 synthetic base-restriction scenarios; FD equality/IN/OR/boolean/exact-expression applicability probes.
experiments.strongest_result: 13 subset/order scenarios match native with maximum relative error 0; direct MCV-first FD-suppression validation.
experiments.does_not_establish: Workload-scale arbitrary expressions, joins, or all FD tie cases.
experiments.paper_section: E1 Native semantic fidelity / E5 composition

experiments.name: CE-Replay-Optimize-v4 joint MCV+FD
experiments.claim: Joint native semantics materially changes mixed physical design and prevents budget waste on suppressed FD objects.
experiments.scope: 468 Census queries, 2,253 MCV and 758 FD candidates, fixed frozen precedence.
experiments.strongest_result: Joint loss 806.444 vs independent 813.942; independent selected 97 FDs, 72 never consumed; joint selected 54, none unconsumed.
experiments.does_not_establish: Global optimality or arbitrary precedence optimization.

experiments.name: CE-Semantic-State-v0
experiments.claim: Execution-sufficient projected state is not restart-sufficient under arbitrary design extension.
experiments.scope: Frozen Census MCV state equivalence and extension counterexamples.
experiments.strongest_result: A lower-OID addition exposes previously irrelevant selected state and invalidates projected-state merging.
experiments.does_not_establish: No impossibility result for every richer state representation.

experiments.name: MCV-Commutativity-v0
experiments.claim: Some MCV actions commute, but canonical OID execution means partial-order reduction does not reduce the tested outer design search.
experiments.scope: Census MCV pairs plus expression counterexample fixture.
experiments.strongest_result: 31.37% of enabled pairs commute; disjointness is exact in the Census fragment.
experiments.does_not_establish: A useful global design-space reduction.

experiments.name: MCV-Semantic-Factorization-v0
experiments.claim: Numerical contribution factors, but Census query-local candidate control graphs do not yield nontrivial factor decomposition.
experiments.scope: Frozen Census MCV plus nontrivial synthetic factor fixture.
experiments.strongest_result: 3,374,717 designs reconstructed within tolerance; every nonempty Census candidate graph remains one factor.
experiments.does_not_establish: Factorization is useless on other workloads.

experiments.name: Semantic-Move-Pruning-v0
experiments.claim: Cached counterfactual toggle responses and safe bounds reproduce the best move in an audited round with far fewer control replays.
experiments.scope: One MCV-only Census SWAP round.
experiments.strongest_result: Same best SWAP, zero false positives, 95.29% cache-eligible, 25.19x fewer control replays.
experiments.does_not_establish: Cross-round cache validity or end-to-end optimizer correctness.

experiments.name: Semantic-Optimizer-v0
experiments.claim: Structural invalidation preserves the complete exhaustive current-neighborhood MCV trajectory and materially reduces control replay and runtime.
experiments.scope: Deterministic MCV-only Census ADD/DROP/SWAP trajectory.
experiments.strongest_result: 17 accepted moves plus terminal round identical; 171.31x fewer control replays and 3.51x phase speedup; zero false prunes/fast paths.
experiments.does_not_establish: Global optimum or mixed-mechanism runtime speedup.

experiments.name: Compositional-Semantic-Optimizer-v0
experiments.claim: Mechanism-aware incremental evaluation preserves the mixed MCV+FD current-neighborhood trajectory and exposes exact directed reuse boundaries.
experiments.scope: Frozen mixed Census design, fixed precedence, ADD/DROP/SWAP best improvement.
experiments.strongest_result: 19 accepted moves and terminal trajectory identical; 95.13% numerical-only; 58.89x locality then 154.61x mechanism control-work reductions.
experiments.does_not_establish: Wall-clock acceleration: semantic implementation took 145.68s versus 45.05s oracle.

experiments.name: Mixed-Deploy-v0
experiments.claim: The final fixed-precedence mixed design can be physically realized; replay matches native fresh CE while frozen-to-fresh payload drift remains separate.
experiments.scope: 205 MCV + 56 FD selected Census design, PostgreSQL 16.14 fresh deployment.
experiments.strongest_result: Frozen/fresh/native loss 805.316/819.191/819.191; 468/468 within 1e-12, max 8.05e-16; semantic loss error zero.
experiments.does_not_establish: Frozen objective predicts fresh objective exactly, or arbitrary intermediate native traces absent instrumentation.

experiments.name: Research-Synthesis-v0
experiments.claim: Historical evidence was assembled and exactness layers were first separated.
experiments.scope: Artifacts through Mixed-Deploy-v0.
experiments.strongest_result: Twenty-one experiments summarized with semantic/move/search exactness distinction.
experiments.does_not_establish: It is synthesis, not new empirical evidence.

experiments.name: Repeated-Analyze-Robustness-v0
experiments.claim: Replay remains exact across payload realizations while ANALYZE sampling creates objective variance and occasional FD availability changes.
experiments.scope: Thirty ANALYZE realizations of one fixed 205-MCV/56-FD design.
experiments.strongest_result: 14,040/14,040 matches within 1e-12; loss CV 1.835%; 462 stable control, 6 varying FD control.
experiments.does_not_establish: Design-ranking instability or a need to redefine the core objective stochastically.

experiments.name: Workload-Generalization-v0
experiments.claim: Fixed-payload train-selected designs often transfer to randomly held-out query instances, imperfectly.
experiments.scope: Ten deterministic 80/20 IID Census splits with global candidate-universe leakage.
experiments.strongest_result: 9/10 positive splits; mean held-out oracle-gap recovery 44.47%; 412/216/312 improved/neutral/regressed instances.
experiments.does_not_establish: Core fixed-workload correctness, unseen templates, distribution shift, or deployment robustness.

experiments.name: Generalization-Mechanism-Analysis-v0
experiments.claim: Held-out positive and harmful transfer can be traced through actual MCV/FD consumption; harmful and missing-benefit effects separate.
experiments.scope: Offline analysis of the same 940 IID held-out instances.
experiments.strongest_result: One-removal diagnostic repairs 93.87% of negative magnitude; best missing add recovers 89.87% of positive train-oracle gap.
experiments.does_not_establish: A feasible robust/generalization-aware design or causal independence of candidate effects.

experiments.name: Budget-Generalization-Curve-v0
experiments.claim: Statistics budget acts as workload-adaptation capacity under train/test interpretation, with non-monotonic held-out behavior.
experiments.scope: Seven budgets x ten existing IID splits, frozen payload.
experiments.strongest_result: 21/60 train-improving/test-worsening transitions; 100% budget best in 2/10 splits.
experiments.does_not_establish: That high budget is globally harmful or that the core target workload is a training set.

experiments.name: Census structural-group audit
experiments.claim: Exact statistics-relevant query signatures do not repeat, so group-disjoint template evaluation is vacuous on Census.
experiments.scope: 468 Census queries; S1 columns, S2 operator classes, S3 exact supported predicate structure.
experiments.strongest_result: 468 groups and 468 singletons at S1, S2, and S3.
experiments.does_not_establish: Absence of a shared generator or absence of partial semantic overlap.

experiments.name: Structural-Distance-Generalization-v0
experiments.claim: Existing nearest-query and union-coverage metrics do not explain held-out transfer; optimizer selection is the main observed filter.
experiments.scope: Offline structural analysis of 940 held-out IID instances.
experiments.strongest_result: Column coverage 100%, candidate coverage mean 96.97%, structural-transfer correlations near zero; selected coverage-consumption Spearman 0.644.
experiments.does_not_establish: Causal effects of structural distance or justification for a similarity embargo.

exactness.semantic: Floating-point agreement with native raw supported CE is established for tested PostgreSQL 16.14 base-restriction MCV/FD settings, not all PostgreSQL CE.
exactness.move_evaluation: Complete tested ADD/DROP/SWAP current-neighborhood trajectories match exhaustive corresponding move evaluators.
exactness.search_optimality: Global optimum is established only for explicitly exhaustive small universes; workload-scale results are deterministic local optima/heuristics.

one_recommended_new_experiment: A second real database/workload end-to-end replication inside the same supported MCV+FD fragment, including semantic fidelity, fixed-workload optimization against simple baselines, and fresh native deployment.
